title: Improving Protein Interaction Prediction in GenPPi: A Novel Interaction Sampling Approach Preserving Network Topology
authors: Alisson William; Iury Godoy; Carlos Marquez; Lucas Silva; Matheus Prado; Natanael Avila; Anderson Rodrigues dos Santos
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍GenPPi 1.5，用随机森林和采样算法改进原核生物PPI网络预测，但对象非无序蛋白/相分离，且无互作机制建模，仅方法上对PPI预测有间接启发。
abstract: Background: Computational prediction of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) is crucial for understanding cell biology and drug development, offering an alternative to costly experimental methods. The original GenPPi software advanced ab initio PPI network prediction from bacterial genomes, but was limited by its reliance on high sequence similarity. This work introduces GenPPi 1.5 to enhance these predictive capabilities. Results: GenPPi 1.5 incorporates a Random Forest (RF) algorithm, trained on 60 biophysical features from amino acid propensity indices, to classify protein similarity even in low sequence identity scenarios (targeting >65% identity). To manage computational complexity from the increased interactions generated by the RF model, especially in extensive conserved phylogenetic profiles, we developed and integrated the Reduced Interaction Sampling (RIS) algorithm. RIS stochastically samples interactions within these profiles, optimizing performance for complete genome analysis. Extensive simulations across various configurations validated the methodology. RF integration significantly broadened GenPPi's predictive power; application to Buchnera aphidicola showed up to 62% overlap with STRING database interactions. Analysis of RIS demonstrated that while introducing some randomness, critical node identification remains robust, particularly for Top N values greater than 100, indicating minimal compromise to network integrity. Conclusion: The combination of Machine Learning (RF) and the RIS algorithm in GenPPi 1.5 represents a significant advancement. It overcomes the high-similarity dependency of the previous version while efficiently handling complex genomes. GenPPi 1.5 provides a robust and scalable alignment-free PPI prediction solution, enabling users to train custom models tailored to specific genomic contexts. GenPPi is freely available on our website (https://genppi.facom.ufu.br/), its source code is hosted on GitHub (https://github.com/santosardr/genppi), and it can be easily installed via the Python Package Index using the command pip install genppi-py.
abstract_zh: 背景：蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的计算预测对于理解细胞生物学和药物开发至关重要，为昂贵的实验方法提供了一种替代方案。原始GenPPi软件推进了基于细菌基因组的从头PPI网络预测，但其依赖于高序列相似性而受限。本研究引入GenPPi 1.5以增强这些预测能力。结果：GenPPi 1.5整合了随机森林（RF）算法，该算法基于氨基酸倾向性指数中的60个生物物理特征进行训练，即使在低序列同一性场景下（目标>65%同一性）也能对蛋白质相似性进行分类。为管理RF模型产生的增加相互作用所带来的计算复杂性，特别是在广泛保守的系统发育谱中，我们开发并整合了减少相互作用采样（RIS）算法。RIS在这些谱内随机采样相互作用，优化了完整基因组分析的性能。跨多种配置的广泛模拟验证了该方法。RF整合显著拓宽了GenPPi的预测能力；应用于蚜虫内共生菌（Buchnera aphidicola）时，与STRING数据库相互作用的重叠度高达62%。对RIS的分析表明，尽管引入了一定随机性，但关键节点识别仍保持稳健，特别是对于大于100的Top N值，表明对网络完整性的影响最小。结论：GenPPi 1.5中机器学习（RF）与RIS算法的结合代表了一项重大进展。它克服了先前版本对高相似性的依赖，同时高效处理复杂基因组。GenPPi 1.5提供了一种稳健且可扩展的无比对PPI预测解决方案，使用户能够针对特定基因组背景训练定制模型。GenPPi可在我们的网站（https://genppi.facom.ufu.br/）免费获取，其源代码托管在GitHub上（https://github.com/santosardr/genppi），并可通过Python包索引使用命令pip install genppi-py轻松安装。
